name: Manyfold platform status
author: Manyfold
description: Manyfold platform health in the Omarchy bar: one icon, and a panel laid out like the website's status page.

barWidget.description: One icon coloured by platform health. Click for the panel: services, the stack, firing alerts, and the checks with uptime and response time.

schema.label: Status API base URL
schema.description: The panel reads health/summary, health, status and status/history under it.

schema.label: Dashboard
schema.description: Empty hides the panel's dashboard button. The installation's Grafana, e.g. https://grafana.<domain>.

schema.label: Refresh interval (seconds)
schema.description: While the panel is open it refreshes every 30 seconds.
